patientRequestRecorded.en: Your request has been recorded for processing.
patientRequestRecorded.translation: A ti kọ ìbéèrè rẹ sílẹ̀ láti ṣiṣẹ́ lórí rẹ.

patientAwaitingReview.en: Your information has been saved for review by the care team.
patientAwaitingReview.translation: A ti fi ìsọfúnni rẹ pamọ́ fún ẹgbẹ́ ìtọju láti ṣàyẹ̀wò.

patientNoCallSummary.en: No clinical summary has been recorded for this call.
patientNoCallSummary.translation: Kò sí àkótán ìlera tí a kọ sílẹ̀ fún ìpè yìí.

welcomeTitle.en: Let's get you ready for your visit.
welcomeTitle.translation: Jẹ́ ká mú ọ ṣetán fún ìbẹ̀wò rẹ.

welcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about your symptoms. Your doctor reviews everything before you meet.
welcomeSubtitle.translation: Dáhùn àwọn ìbéèrè díẹ̀ nípa àwọn àmì àìsàn rẹ. Dókítà rẹ yóò ṣàyẹ̀wò gbogbo rẹ kí ẹ tó pàdé.

identitySubtitle.en: This connects your visit to your record.
identitySubtitle.translation: Èyí so ìbẹ̀wò rẹ pọ̀ mọ́ àkọsílẹ̀ rẹ.

labelComplaint.translation: Kí ló mú ọ wá lónìí?

interviewAsking.translation: À ń béèrè nípa àwọn àmì àìsàn rẹ

interviewLoading.translation: À ń ṣí àwọn ìbéèrè rẹ…

interviewLoadError.translation: A kò lè ṣí àwọn ìbéèrè rẹ.

interviewComplete.en: Thanks, {name}. I have what I need. Let's review your answers before sending them to the doctor.
interviewComplete.translation: Ẹ ṣé, {name}. Mo ti rí ohun tí mo nílò. Jẹ́ ká ṣàyẹ̀wò àwọn ìdáhùn rẹ kí a tó fi ránṣẹ́ sí dókítà.

interviewOpener.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about your {complaint}. When did it start?
interviewOpener.translation: Ẹ ṣé — màá béèrè àwọn ìbéèrè díẹ̀ nípa {complaint} rẹ. Nígbà wo ló bẹ̀rẹ̀?

interviewOpenerFallback.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about what brought you in. When did it start?
interviewOpenerFallback.translation: Ẹ ṣé — màá béèrè àwọn ìbéèrè díẹ̀ nípa ohun tó mú ọ wá. Nígbà wo ló bẹ̀rẹ̀?

composerHintChips.en: Type a reply, or tap a suggestion above
composerHintChips.translation: Tẹ ìdáhùn, tàbí tẹ àbá kan lókè

severityWorst.translation: Ó le jù gbogbo èyí tí mo ti ní lọ

reviewTitle.translation: Èyí ni ohun tí mo kọ sílẹ̀

reviewSubtitle.en: Tap any item to fix it before sending.
reviewSubtitle.translation: Tẹ ohun kan láti ṣàtúnṣe rẹ kí o tó fi ránṣẹ́.

labelCharacter.translation: Bí ó ṣe ń rí lára

labelRadiation.translation: Ibi tí ìrora ń tàn sí

labelAssociated.translation: Àwọn àmì míì tó bá a wá

btnSendToDoctor.translation: Ó tọ́ — fi ránṣẹ́ sí dókítà

emergencyNotice.en: If your symptoms feel severe or are getting worse right now, don't wait — call emergency services.
emergencyNotice.translation: Tí àwọn àmì àìsàn rẹ bá le tàbí tí wọ́n ń burú sí i báyìí, má dúró — pe àwọn iṣẹ́ pajawiri.

urgencyBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that should be seen soon. We've flagged your case as urgent for the clinical team.
urgencyBody.translation: Àwọn àmì àìsàn rẹ fi hàn pé ó yẹ kí a rí ọ láìpẹ́. A ti sọ fún ẹgbẹ́ ìtọju pé ọ̀ràn rẹ nílò ìtọju kánkán.

urgencyNextSteps.translation: Ohun tó máa ṣẹlẹ̀ lẹ́yìn èyí

urgencyStep1Title.translation: A ń fi àkótán rẹ ránṣẹ́ báyìí

urgencyStep1Desc.en: The clinical team receives your structured history immediately.
urgencyStep1Desc.translation: Ẹgbẹ́ ìtọju yóò gba ìtàn ìlera rẹ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.

urgencyStep2Desc.en: Based on {level} urgency. You will be notified when a clinician opens it.
urgencyStep2Desc.translation: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìpele ìkánjú {level}. A ó sọ fún ọ nígbà tí òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera bá ṣí i.

urgencyStep3Title.translation: Tí ó bá burú sí i, ṣe ohun tó yẹ kíákíá

urgencyStep3Desc.en: Severe or sudden worsening — call emergency services right away.
urgencyStep3Desc.translation: Tí ó bá le tàbí burú sí i lójijì — pe àwọn iṣẹ́ pajawiri lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.

notADiagnosis.en: This is an automated urgency estimate, not a diagnosis. A clinician makes the final decision.
notADiagnosis.translation: Èyí jẹ́ ìṣírò ìkánjú látọ̀dọ̀ ẹ̀rọ, kì í ṣe àyẹ̀wò ìdánimọ̀ àìsàn. Òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera ló máa pinnu ní ìkẹyìn.

notADiagnosisBold.translation: Kì í ṣe àyẹ̀wò ìdánimọ̀ àìsàn

findHeroSubtitle.en: You've been seen at this hospital before. Send your brief straight there?
findHeroSubtitle.translation: A ti tọ́jú rẹ ní ilé ìwòsàn yìí rí. Ṣé ká fi àkótán rẹ ránṣẹ́ síbẹ̀ tààrà?

findHeroEta.translation: Àkókò ìdúró tí a fojú díwọ̀n

findHeroDoctors.translation: Àwọn dókítà tó wà lẹ́nu iṣẹ́

findHeroRecordsNote.en: They already hold your records, so your care team sees your full history right away.
findHeroRecordsNote.translation: Wọ́n ti ní àkọsílẹ̀ rẹ, nítorí náà ẹgbẹ́ ìtọju rẹ lè rí gbogbo ìtàn rẹ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.

findSearchTitle.en: Where would you like to be seen?
findSearchTitle.translation: Níbo ni o fẹ́ gba ìtọju?

findSearchSubtitle.en: Pick a Triavi hospital near you — your {level} brief is sent the moment you choose.
findSearchSubtitle.translation: Yan ilé ìwòsàn Triavi tó sún mọ́ ọ — a ó fi àkótán ìpele {level} rẹ ránṣẹ́ ní kété tí o bá yàn.

findScanning.translation: À ń wá àwọn ilé ìwòsàn Triavi tó sún mọ́ ọ…

findHospitalsNear.translation: Ilé ìwòsàn {count} tó sún mọ́ ọ

findSortedByDistance.translation: · a tò wọ́n ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú ìjìnnà

findErrLocation.en: We couldn't get your location. Tap rescan to try again.
findErrLocation.translation: A kò lè rí ibi tí o wà. Tẹ wíwá lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.

statusBody.en: Your brief is with the care team. We'll notify you the moment a clinician opens it.
statusBody.translation: Àkótán rẹ wà lọ́wọ́ ẹgbẹ́ ìtọju. A ó sọ fún ọ ní kété tí òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera bá ṣí i.

statEstWait.translation: Àkókò ìdúró tí a fojú díwọ̀n

timelineSubmitted.translation: A ti fi àwọn ìdáhùn ránṣẹ́

timelineOpened.translation: Òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera kan ti ṣí àkótán rẹ

btnSymptomsWorse.translation: Àwọn àmì àìsàn burú sí i

escalateTitle.en: If it's getting worse, act now
escalateTitle.translation: Tí ó bá ń burú sí i, ṣe ohun tó yẹ báyìí

escalateBody.en: Don't wait for your queue position. If your symptoms are severe or worsening suddenly — call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
escalateBody.translation: Má dúró de ipò rẹ nínú ìlà. Tí àwọn àmì àìsàn rẹ bá le tàbí burú sí i lójijì — pe àwọn iṣẹ́ pajawiri báyìí tàbí lọ sí ẹ̀ka pajawiri tó sún mọ́ ọ jù.

escalateNotDiagnosis.translation: Kì í ṣe àyẹ̀wò ìdánimọ̀ àìsàn

escalateFlagged.en: We've flagged your case as higher priority so the care team is aware.
escalateFlagged.translation: A ti gbé ọ̀ràn rẹ sí ipò pàtàkì sí i kí ẹgbẹ́ ìtọju lè mọ̀.

notifyTitle.translation: Triavi · A ti ṣí àkótán rẹ

notifyBody.en: A clinician is reviewing your brief. We'll update you as it progresses.
notifyBody.translation: Òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera ń ṣàyẹ̀wò àkótán rẹ. A ó máa jẹ́ kí o mọ bí ó ṣe ń lọ.

checkinWelcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about how you've been since your visit.
checkinWelcomeSubtitle.translation: Dáhùn àwọn ìbéèrè díẹ̀ nípa bí ara rẹ ti rí látìgbà ìbẹ̀wò rẹ.

checkinTrendAriaLabel.en: How is your condition compared to before?
checkinTrendAriaLabel.translation: Báwo ni ara rẹ ṣe rí ní ìfiwéra pẹ̀lú tẹ́lẹ̀?

checkinAnythingElse.en: Anything else you'd like to tell us?
checkinAnythingElse.translation: Ṣé ohun mìíràn wà tí o fẹ́ sọ fún wa?

checkinResultResolved.translation: Inú wa dùn pé ara rẹ ti dára sí i

checkinResultResolvedBody.en: We'll check in again {next} to make sure you're still improving.
checkinResultResolvedBody.translation: A ó tún béèrè lọ́wọ́ rẹ {next} láti rí i dájú pé ara rẹ ṣì ń yá.

checkinResultReview.en: A clinician will look at this today
checkinResultReview.translation: Òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera yóò ṣàyẹ̀wò èyí lónìí

checkinResultReviewBody.en: Your answers have been sent to the care team. A clinician will review them and reach out if needed.
checkinResultReviewBody.translation: A ti fi àwọn ìdáhùn rẹ ránṣẹ́ sí ẹgbẹ́ ìtọju. Òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera yóò ṣàyẹ̀wò wọn, yóò sì kàn sí ọ tí ó bá yẹ.

checkinResultEscalateBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that needs prompt attention. Don't wait — contact your care team or go to the nearest emergency department.
checkinResultEscalateBody.translation: Àwọn àmì àìsàn rẹ nílò àfiyèsí kánkán. Má dúró — kàn sí ẹgbẹ́ ìtọju rẹ tàbí lọ sí ẹ̀ka pajawiri tó sún mọ́ ọ jù.

checkinExpired.translation: Àkókò ìjápọ̀ ìforúkọsílẹ̀ yìí ti parí

checkinExpiredBody.en: This follow-up is no longer available. Sign in to see your current check-ins.
checkinExpiredBody.translation: Ìtọ́pinpin yìí kò sí mọ́. Wọlé láti rí àwọn ìforúkọsílẹ̀ rẹ tó wà lọ́wọ́.

claimBody.en: Your check-in is verified. Create a free account to track this visit and skip the code next time.
claimBody.translation: A ti jẹ́rìí sí ìforúkọsílẹ̀ rẹ. Ṣẹ̀dá àkọọ́lẹ̀ ọ̀fẹ́ láti tọ́pinpin ìbẹ̀wò yìí, kí o má nílò kóòdù nígbà tó kàn.

authVerifyTitle.translation: Jẹ́ ká jẹ́rìí pé ìwọ ni

authVerifyBody.en: We'll send a one-time code — no password to remember.
authVerifyBody.translation: A ó fi kóòdù ìlò ẹ̀ẹ̀kan ránṣẹ́ — kò sí ọ̀rọ̀ aṣínà láti rántí.

authSecuredBy.translation: Triavi ń dáàbò bò ó · Ó tẹ̀lé HIPAA

otpSentTo.en: Sent to {dest}. It expires in 10 minutes.
otpSentTo.translation: A ti fi ránṣẹ́ sí {dest}. Yóò parí ní ìṣẹ́jú 10.

signinBody.en: Enter your phone or email and we'll send a sign-in code.
signinBody.translation: Tẹ nọ́mbà fóònù tàbí ímeèlì rẹ, a ó sì fi kóòdù ìwọlé ránṣẹ́.

signinAccountTied.en: Your account is tied to your hospital's records
signinAccountTied.translation: Àkọọ́lẹ̀ rẹ so pọ̀ mọ́ àkọsílẹ̀ ilé ìwòsàn rẹ

errInvalidPhone.en: Enter a valid phone number (7–14 digits)

errSendFailed.en: Couldn't send the code. Try again.
errSendFailed.translation: A kò lè fi kóòdù ránṣẹ́. Gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.

errNetwork.en: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errNetwork.translation: Àṣìṣe ìsopọ̀. Ṣàyẹ̀wò ìsopọ̀ rẹ kí o tún gbìyànjú.

errResendFailed.translation: A kò lè tún fi ránṣẹ́. Gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.

errCodeMismatch.en: That code didn't match. Try again.
errCodeMismatch.translation: Kóòdù náà kò bá a mu. Gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.

sessionExpiredBody.en: For your security and to protect patient data, you've been signed out after a period of inactivity.
sessionExpiredBody.translation: Fún ààbò rẹ àti láti dáàbò bo ìsọfúnni aláìsàn, a ti mú ọ jáde lẹ́yìn àkókò tí o kò lò ó.

dashNoActive.translation: Kò sí ìbẹ̀wò tó ń lọ lọ́wọ́

dashNoActiveHint.en: Start a check-in to begin a new visit.

dashNoPastVisits.translation: Kò tíì sí ìbẹ̀wò tó kọjá.

dashEstWait.translation: Àkókò ìdúró tí a fojú díwọ̀n

dashAnswersSubmitted.translation: A ti fi àwọn ìdáhùn ránṣẹ́

dashCareLinePrivacy.en: Care calls ring in this app · your phone number is never shared.
dashCareLinePrivacy.translation: Ìpè ìtọju ń wọ inú ètò yìí · a kò pín nọ́mbà fóònù rẹ.

dashSimulateCall.translation: Dán ìpè ìtọju tó ń wọlé wò · àfihàn

voiceSubtitle.en: Choose who calls you, and how they sound.
voiceSubtitle.translation: Yan ẹni tó máa pè ọ àti bí ohùn rẹ ṣe máa rí.

toneWarmDesc.translation: Ó ń mú ọkàn balẹ̀, kò kánjú

toneProfessionalDesc.translation: Tààrà, pàtó, kò sí ọ̀rọ̀ àfikún

toneUpbeatDesc.translation: Ìwà ọ̀rẹ́ tó ń fúnni níṣìírí

voiceSampleQuote.en: Hi Jordan, it's time for your evening dose…
voiceSampleQuote.translation: Báwo Jordan, àkókò oògùn alẹ́ rẹ ti tó…

medReminderCallsDesc.translation: Pe ní gbogbo àkókò oògùn tí a ṣètò

postVisitCallsDesc.translation: “Báwo ni ara rẹ?” lẹ́yìn ìjáde kúrò ní ilé ìwòsàn

quietHoursDesc.en: No calls 9:30 PM – 7:30 AM · falls back to a notification
quietHoursDesc.translation: Kò sí ìpè láti 9:30 alẹ́ sí 7:30 òwúrọ̀ · ìfitónilétí dípò rẹ

signedOutBody.en: Your care line stays active — sign back in to manage calls and reminders.
signedOutBody.translation: Ìlà ìtọju rẹ ṣì ń ṣiṣẹ́ — wọlé lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i láti ṣàkóso ìpè àti ìránnilétí.

callRingVerified.translation: A ti jẹ́rìí · nípasẹ̀ ìlà ìtọju rẹ {code}

callRingWebRtcFootnote.en: Encrypted voice call · WebRTC · your number is never shared
callRingWebRtcFootnote.translation: Ìpè ohùn tí a dáàbò bò · WebRTC · a kò pín nọ́mbà rẹ

callActiveEndConfirm.translation: Ṣé o fẹ́ parí ìpè yìí?

callSummaryReported.translation: A TI SỌ FÚN ẸGBẸ́ ÌTỌJU RẸ

callSummarySnoozed.translation: A SUN ÌRÁNNILÉTÍ SÍWÁJÚ NÍ WÁKÀTÍ 1

callSummaryNoContact.translation: A KỌ SÍLẸ̀ PÉ KÒ SÍ ÌDÁHÙN

visitsPrivacyNote.en: Only you and {hospital} can see these. Tap a visit to read the summary shared with you.
visitsPrivacyNote.translation: Ìwọ àti {hospital} nìkan lè rí èyí. Tẹ ìbẹ̀wò kan láti ka àkótán tí a pín pẹ̀lú rẹ.

visitDetailCalls.translation: ÀWỌN ÌPÈ ÌTỌJU FÚN ÌBẸ̀WÒ YÌÍ

visitDetailNoCalls.en: No care calls for this visit yet.
visitDetailNoCalls.translation: Kò tíì sí ìpè ìtọju fún ìbẹ̀wò yìí.

visitDetailNotDiagnosis.en: This is a summary shared with you — not a diagnosis. If your symptoms return or get worse, seek emergency care right away.
visitDetailNotDiagnosis.translation: Àkótán tí a pín pẹ̀lú rẹ ni èyí — kì í ṣe àyẹ̀wò ìdánimọ̀ àìsàn. Tí àwọn àmì rẹ bá padà tàbí burú sí i, wá ìtọju pajawiri lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.

visitDetailNotFoundBody.en: This visit may have been removed, or the link is no longer valid. Go back to see your full history.
visitDetailNotFoundBody.translation: A lè ti yọ ìbẹ̀wò yìí kúrò, tàbí ìjápọ̀ náà kò ṣiṣẹ́ mọ́. Padà láti rí gbogbo ìtàn rẹ.

visitDetailBackToVisits.translation: Padà sí àwọn ìbẹ̀wò tó kọjá

visitDetailDischargeBadge.translation: Ẹgbẹ́ ìtọju rẹ ti jẹ́ kí o lọ sílé

editProfileSubtitle.en: Update your details. Your doctor sees the latest.
editProfileSubtitle.translation: Ṣe àfikún sí ìsọfúnni rẹ. Dókítà rẹ yóò rí tuntun.

labelEmergencyContact.translation: Ẹni láti kàn sí ní pajawiri

placeholderEmergencyName.translation: Orúkọ ẹni láti kàn sí ní pajawiri

profilePreferredLanguageDesc.en: Changes the language of every screen instantly.
profilePreferredLanguageDesc.translation: Ó yí èdè gbogbo ojú ìwé padà lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.

profileCareLineCopyFailed.en: Couldn't copy - select and copy manually
profileCareLineCopyFailed.translation: A kò lè ṣe ẹ̀dà — yan án kí o ṣe ẹ̀dà fúnra rẹ

privacySubtitle.en: What we protect, and what you control.
privacySubtitle.translation: Ohun tí a ń dáàbò bò, àti ohun tí o ń ṣàkóso.

privacyDeidTitle.translation: Ó máa ń ṣiṣẹ́ nígbà gbogbo

privacyDeidBody.en: Your name, contact details, and free-text answers are stripped before anything leaves your hospital. Only your care team sees identifying details; research and analytics see de-identified data only.
privacyDeidBody.translation: A yọ orúkọ rẹ, àlàyé ìkànsí àti àwọn ìdáhùn tí o kọ kúrò kí ohunkóhun tó kúrò ní ilé ìwòsàn rẹ. Ẹgbẹ́ ìtọju rẹ nìkan ló rí àlàyé tó lè fi ọ hàn; ìwádìí àti ìtúpalẹ̀ rí ìsọfúnni tí kò ní ìdánimọ̀ nìkan.

privacyDeidLockLabel.translation: A ti tì í sí ipò ìṣiṣẹ́

privacyResearchConsentDesc.en: Allow de-identified data to improve care for everyone. You can change this anytime.
privacyResearchConsentDesc.translation: Gba lílo ìsọfúnni tí kò ní ìdánimọ̀ láàyè láti mú ìtọju gbogbo ènìyàn dára sí i. O lè yí èyí padà nígbàkigbà.

privacyCommsConsentDesc.en: Appointment reminders and follow-up check-ins by call or push. You can change this anytime.
privacyCommsConsentDesc.translation: Ìránnilétí àdéhùn àti ìforúkọsílẹ̀ ìtọ́pinpin nípasẹ̀ ìpè tàbí ìfitónilétí. O lè yí èyí padà nígbàkigbà.

privacyDeleteDesc.en: Permanently remove your account and contact details. Your care-line history is retained by your hospital as required by law.
privacyDeleteDesc.translation: Yọ àkọọ́lẹ̀ àti àlàyé ìkànsí rẹ kúrò pátápátá. Ilé ìwòsàn rẹ yóò pa ìtàn ìlà ìtọju rẹ mọ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí òfin ṣe béèrè.

privacyDownloadDesc.en: Request a copy of your visit summaries, medications, and care-call history.
privacyDownloadDesc.translation: Béèrè ẹ̀dà àkótán ìbẹ̀wò, oògùn àti ìtàn ìpè ìtọju rẹ.

deleteSheetTitle.translation: Ṣé o fẹ́ pa àkọọ́lẹ̀ rẹ rẹ́?

deleteSheetBody.en: This permanently removes your account and contact details. Your hospital retains your care-line history as required by law. This cannot be undone.
deleteSheetBody.translation: Èyí yọ àkọọ́lẹ̀ àti àlàyé ìkànsí rẹ kúrò pátápátá. Ilé ìwòsàn rẹ yóò pa ìtàn ìlà ìtọju rẹ mọ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí òfin ṣe béèrè. A kò lè dá èyí padà.

deleteRequestSubmitted.translation: A ti fi ìbéèrè píparẹ́ ránṣẹ́

deleteRequestNextStep.en: Your care team will confirm by email within 72 hours. Your care line stays active until then.
deleteRequestNextStep.translation: Ẹgbẹ́ ìtọju rẹ yóò jẹ́rìí nípasẹ̀ ímeèlì láàárín wákàtí 72. Ìlà ìtọju rẹ yóò máa ṣiṣẹ́ títí di ìgbà náà.

downloadSheetBody.en: Choose a format and request your export. We'll prepare it and send a secure link to your registered email.
downloadSheetBody.translation: Yan ọ̀nà fáìlì kí o béèrè àkọsílẹ̀ rẹ. A ó pèsè rẹ̀, a ó sì fi ìjápọ̀ ààbò ránṣẹ́ sí ímeèlì tí o forúkọsílẹ̀.

downloadRequestSubmitted.translation: A ti fi ìbéèrè àkọsílẹ̀ ránṣẹ́

downloadRequestNextStep.en: We'll email a secure link to your registered address within 24 hours.
downloadRequestNextStep.translation: A ó fi ìjápọ̀ ààbò ránṣẹ́ sí ímeèlì tí o forúkọsílẹ̀ láàárín wákàtí 24.

questionOnset.translation: Nígbà wo ni àwọn àmì àìsàn rẹ bẹ̀rẹ̀?

questionContext.en: Were you resting or active when it began?
questionContext.translation: Ṣé o ń sinmi tàbí o ń ṣiṣẹ́ nígbà tó bẹ̀rẹ̀?

questionSeverity.en: How strong is the discomfort right now?
questionSeverity.translation: Báwo ni ìrora tàbí ìdààmú náà ṣe le tó báyìí?

questionRadiation.translation: Ṣé ìrora náà ń tàn sí ibòmíràn?

questionAssociated.en: Are you noticing any of these as well?
questionAssociated.translation: Ṣé o tún ń kíyè sí èyíkéyìí nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí?

choiceChest.translation: Ó wà ní àyà mi nìkan

choiceNausea.translation: Rírí bí ẹni pé màá bì

followupPain.en: How is your pain compared to when you were discharged?
followupPain.translation: Báwo ni ìrora rẹ ṣe rí ní ìfiwéra pẹ̀lú ìgbà tí o jáde ní ilé ìwòsàn?

followupMeds.en: Have you been taking your medications as prescribed?
followupMeds.translation: Ṣé o ń lo oògùn rẹ gẹ́gẹ́ bí dókítà ṣe sọ?

followupFever.en: Do you still have a fever?

followupBreathing.translation: Ṣé o ń mí láìsí ìṣòro?

followupEating.en: Are you able to eat and drink normally?
followupEating.translation: Ṣé o lè jẹun kí o sì mu omi bí o ti máa ń ṣe?

choiceMissedMeds.translation: Rárá, mo fo ìwọ̀n oògùn díẹ̀

choiceHighFever.translation: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni (38°C tàbí jù bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ)

choiceNormalBreath.translation: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, mo ń mí dáadáa

choiceHardBreath.translation: Ó ń ṣòro fún mi láti mí

choiceLessFood.translation: Mo ń jẹun díẹ̀ ju tẹ́lẹ̀ lọ

choiceNoFluids.translation: Mo ń bì ohun tí mo mu

questionLocation.en: Where do you feel the symptoms?
questionLocation.translation: Níbo ni o ti ń ní àwọn àmì náà?

questionModifiers.en: What makes the symptoms better or worse?
questionModifiers.translation: Kí ló ń mú àwọn àmì náà dára tàbí burú sí i?

questionReady.en: Your answers are ready for review.
questionReady.translation: Àwọn ìdáhùn rẹ ti ṣetán fún àyẹ̀wò.

errRequest.en: We could not complete your request. Please try again.
errRequest.translation: A kò lè parí ìbéèrè rẹ. Jọ̀wọ́ gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.

demoOnset.translation: Nǹkan bí wákàtí 1–3 sẹ́yìn, nígbà ìsinmi

questionDuration.en: How long have you had this?
questionDuration.translation: Ó ti pẹ́ tó tí o ti ní èyí?

questionCharacter.en: How would you describe the quality of the discomfort?
questionCharacter.translation: Báwo ni o ṣe lè ṣàpèjúwe irú ìrora tàbí ìdààmú náà?

questionAggravating.translation: Kí ló ń mú un burú sí i?

questionRelieving.translation: Kí ló ń mú un dára sí i?

questionPrior.translation: Ṣé o ti ní irú èyí rí?

questionMedications.en: What medications are you currently taking?
questionMedications.translation: Àwọn oògùn wo ni o ń lò báyìí?

questionAllergies.translation: Ṣé o ní ohun tí ara rẹ kò gbà, bí oògùn tàbí oúnjẹ?

questionHistory.en: Any relevant medical history I should know about?
questionHistory.translation: Ṣé ìtàn ìlera pàtàkì kan wà tí ó yẹ kí n mọ̀?

questionRedFlags.en: Are you experiencing any severe or alarming symptoms?
questionRedFlags.translation: Ṣé o ní àwọn àmì àìsàn tó le tàbí tó ń kó ìdààmú bá ọ?

questionSeverityScale.en: How strong is the discomfort right now, from 0 to 10?
questionSeverityScale.translation: Láti 0 sí 10, báwo ni ìrora tàbí ìdààmú náà ṣe le tó báyìí?

callBackHour.en: We'll call you back in 1 hour · {hospital}

demoCallEvening.en: I'm calling to remind you about your evening dose of {med}.
demoCallEvening.translation: Mo ń pè láti rán ọ létí ìwọ̀n oògùn alẹ́ rẹ, {med}.

demoCallDue.en: It's 8 o'clock — time for your {med}. Have you taken it yet?
demoCallDue.translation: Agogo 8 ti lù — àkókò {med} rẹ ti tó. Ṣé o ti lò ó?

callReportedTaken.translation: a ròyìn pé a ti lo oògùn
